summary: Although named hybrid, this build's CMake compiles CUDA and the timed computation uses the GPU kernel, not CPU repetition. MPI rank slices are rebased and every selected GROUP specialization traverses each row's full CSR interval and stores. Host timed count loop repeatedly invokes the selector before synchronization. Five SASS variants are embedded.

source_evidence.claim: Build uses CUDA translation unit, despite no explicit OpenMP linkage relevance to timed kernel path.
Group-size CSR GPU kernel, MPI row/nnz slice and timed iteration launches.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed runtime counter encloses launch path and synchronization follows.

Also checked corrected r1 source split and complete timed host/long-row worker chain. Other IDs rely on Luna inspection plus primary report and pinned-evidence checks.

Expanded source references to complete cited files.
Added r2 compiled 32-launch graph-capture loop and complete timed worker including sixth launch specialization and synchronization.
